title: Topic 3.1: Scriptural Stories and Family Values

pages.lesson:
LESSON: SCRIPTURAL STORIES AND FAMILY VALUES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Scriptures (Dharam Granths)
Topic 3.1: Scriptural Stories and Family Values

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Scriptural Stories and Family Values. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do Scriptures contribute to instilling moral values?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the teachings of Scriptures at family level for development of moral values
2. demonstrate the teachings that promote moral values in families as per selected Scriptures from the four faiths

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the teachings of Scriptures at family level for development of moral values
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the teachings of Scriptures at family level for development of moral values. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate the teachings that promote moral values in families as per selected Scriptures from the four faiths
   In simple words: practise until you can demonstrate the teachings that promote moral values in families as per selected Scriptures from the four faiths. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Scriptural Stories and Family Values using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Scriptural Stories and Family Values in the examples.
2. Explain Scriptural Stories and Family Values to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Scriptural Stories and Family Values.
4. Show that you can: identify the teachings of Scriptures at family level for development of moral values

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Scriptural Stories and Family Values using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Scriptural Stories and Family Values important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Listen to stories/resource person/ audio- visual device to find and tell stories from Scriptures that explain their roles as carrier of moral values,
2. Is able to relate the skill of using digital devices while watching animated stories of scriptures of four faiths to the skills of using digital devices in Creative Arts.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do Scriptures contribute to instilling moral values?
2. How can we apply moral values in different situations in the family?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the teachings of Scriptures at family level for development of moral values
2. demonstrate the teachings that promote moral values in families as per selected Scriptures from the four faiths

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
